stage_guidance.direct_rag: Ground every hop in the supplied KG triples, table rows, or text passages, and distinguish an exact graph edge from prose context and row operations.
stage_guidance.search: Identify only the entity requested at the current hop from the supplied evidence.
stage_guidance.relate: Extract the requested relation value exactly, including series order, author, publisher, award, date, or character role.
stage_guidance.filter: Apply every condition to the candidate set; use Table for row filters and KG qualifiers when explicitly supplied.
stage_guidance.answer_from_child_qa: Resolve [n] dependencies in order and report only the final requested answer.
